post_swap_verification.method: in-place row-nesting check on swapped arrays (finer-rung condition rows verbatim at coarser rung, all rung pairs)

consequences: ifc model-anchor cells from anchor_summary_3seed_2026-08-03.json are VOID (measured on shipped rows); re-score on repaired rows is a launch prerequisite (ADR D3/D6).
Round-2 ifc numbers and repaired-ladder ifc numbers are never comparable.
cat.pkl / scalers were fit on shipped rows and are deliberately NOT carried over; the ifc_raw loader does not read them.
